target_customer: Music creators and e-commerce sellers and marketers who want AI generated videos and ads (inferred from feature groups, not stated)
problem: Producing music videos, ads and short videos is slow and costly; AIVideo.com generates them with AI tools and a service layer.
business_model: Subscription and credit based AI video platform plus production as a service

founders.name: Justin Harvey
founders.background_notes: Worked with Orestis Lykouropoulos on an earlier startup per YC page.

founders.name: Eduardo Faraday
founders.background_notes: Product lead at Oasis, which he credits with first AI video avatars.

founders.name: Orestis Lykouropoulos
founders.background_notes: Greek born software engineer and composer.

competitors.name: Runway
competitors.what: Text to video model Gen 2 and creative tools

competitors.name: Pika
competitors.what: Text and image to video generation
competitors.funding_then: Series A in late 2023, after the batch

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly orchestrating third party generative models into a production workflow with editing tools; model training was not the core.

defensibility.rationale: Underlying models are available to all and many rivals launched in 2023; product breadth and user workflows are the only edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Model makers kept adding native video features; no acquisition of AIVideo.com found.

market_need_then: a16z called 2023 AI video's breakout year with 21 public products tracked, and creators and marketers wanted cheap video production.

branding.domain_note: Holds the exact .com aivideo.com; how it was acquired was not found.

identity.logo: Wordmark file named aivideo-logo, design not visible
identity.voice_and_tone: Energetic, short action prompts such as What will you CREATE today.

brand_strength.rationale: A premium exact match .com helps search, but the name is generic and no press or community about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: AIVideo.com joined YC in Summer 2023, is active with a team of 12, and has expanded from music visuals into e-commerce ad tools. No news of a shutdown, acquisition or layoffs was found. Funding is reported only by aggregators, and the market is crowded with model makers, so the outcome is unproven.
notes: Seedtable lists a $6.2M seed dated 2023-08, citing a LinkedIn post by co-founder Eduardo Faraday that it closed about six weeks into YC S23; the round rests on this single database and the LinkedIn claim, no press release found. Another site lists a seed in February 2025 from Unpopular Ventures and Simma Capital with no amount; it may be the same round mislabeled, so not recorded. Competitor pages are loosely dated 2023. Whether the company operated under a different product (Infobot.ai) at founding is unclear.
